lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Joly, Stellantis officials set for latest showdown on Friday, The Canadian Press reports.
Alex Kelly has gone from the bright lights of the Stratford Festival to the crime-ridden streets of Vice City, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump defends calling Putin a friend but says he ‘can’t speak’ to whether he’s a friend to the U.S, The Canadian Press reports.
Exam shows that hat Fiona the hippo ate was deep into her small intestine, The Canadian Press reports.
B.C.’s first Conservative government in almost a century will take power when Lorne Doerkson becomes premier and unveils his first cabinet, The Canadian Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
